synthetic_controls: Existing control_cases()[contract-controls], all seven snapshots retained. Four text observations (one prefilled), two checkbox states, one submit button. Button scored separately as action contract.

supplemental.policy: Append the same six plausible distractor entities after every original profile, independent of target field. Correct original entities remain present. Run every condition on every snapshot; report separately from primary.

scoring.truth_access: Use existing scenario constructor only through a one-way public projection; no private truth is consulted or passed for inference. Separate private grading runs after every forward pass and reproducibility repeat completes.
scoring.field_value: Existing semantic-2 effective-value/action correctness, with original normalization; all selected fills retain their value. No browser select translation in decision-only snapshots.
scoring.strict_assignment: Existing semantic-2: only correct fill/check assignments; skips remain in denominator.
scoring.required_empty_skip: skip count divided by required scored observations with initially empty values.
scoring.wrong_value: Wrong fill count divided by all scored field observations; also report among fills.
scoring.optional_acceptability: Correct effective-value action or empty optional skip.
scoring.button: Contract-only click correctness, excluded from field-value denominators.
scoring.coverage: Primary changed-label subset7; inclusive familiar13 secondary; excluded10 separate; serialization comparison all23. Cases repeated across conditions are paired, not independent.
scoring.confidence: Mean and min/max selected probability over incorrect field predictions; separately incorrect required skips and >0.99 confidence counts.
scoring.paired: B-A and D-C label effects; C-A and D-B serialization; D-C-B+A interaction on same subset. Per-field transitions and counts for every contrast.
scoring.uncertainty: Descriptive case study of three deliberately designated development cases and one profile, correlated fields. No significance or general-population claims.
